attr.title: Pathogenic
attr.desc: A cellular roguelike twin-stick shooter where you play as a disease infecting a human host. Collect organelles to evolve your parasite while battling the immune system across procedurally generated body environments.
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Steam and copy pathogenic.pck from the game's installation folder (Steam: Manage, Browse local files) into ports/pathogenic/gamedata/. The first start prepares the game for your device, which takes a few minutes and needs up to about 1 GB of extra space (about 150 MB at 640x480, more on bigger screens).
